description: Audit whether a WordPress plugin or classic theme is WPML-compatible end to end. Use when asked "is this plugin WPML compatible?", "why does this shortcode/string/page not translate?", or when code has wpml-config.xml, stored page/product/term IDs, get_permalink/home_url, shortcode attributes, get_option option strings, custom tables, WooCommerce order/product data, emails/PDFs/background jobs, wpml_register_single_string, wpml_translate_single_string, wpml_object_id, wpml_permalink, or wpml_switch_language.
